audit_status.source_base: Greek Ephesians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for imitation/love, light, wisdom, Spirit-filled life, mutual submission, marriage household code with domination safeguard.

verses.restored: Become therefore imitators of the Divine, as beloved children,

familiar.text: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;

modern.text: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,

original.text: γίνεσθε οὖν μιμηταὶ τοῦ θεοῦ, ὡς τέκνα ἀγαπητά,

verses.restored: and walk in love, just as also Messiah loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and sacrifice to the Divine for fragrant aroma.

familiar.text: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

modern.text: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.

original.text: καὶ περιπατεῖτε ἐν ἀγάπῃ, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν ⸀ἡμᾶς καὶ παρέδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ⸀ἡμῶν προσφορὰν καὶ θυσίαν τῷ θεῷ εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας.

verses.restored: But sexual immorality/misuse and every uncleanness or greed, let it not even be named among you, as is fitting for holy ones,

familiar.text: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

modern.text: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.

original.text: Πορνεία δὲ καὶ ⸂ἀκαθαρσία πᾶσα⸃ ἢ πλεονεξία μηδὲ ὀνομαζέσθω ἐν ὑμῖν, καθὼς πρέπει ἁγίοις,

verses.restored: and shamefulness and foolish talk or coarse joking, which are not fitting, but rather thanksgiving.

familiar.text: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

modern.text: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of character, but rather thanksgiving.

original.text: καὶ αἰσχρότης καὶ μωρολογία ἢ εὐτραπελία, ⸂ἃ οὐκ ἀνῆκεν⸃, ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον εὐχαριστία.

verses.restored: For this you know, recognizing that every sexually immoral/misusing or unclean or greedy person, who is an idolater, has no inheritance in the reign of Messiah and Divine.

familiar.text: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

modern.text: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

original.text: τοῦτο γὰρ ⸀ἴστε γινώσκοντες ὅτι πᾶς πόρνος ἢ ἀκάθαρτος ἢ πλεονέκτης, ⸀ὅ ἐστιν εἰδωλολάτρης, οὐκ ἔχει κληρονομίαν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ θεοῦ.

verses.restored: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of the Divine comes upon the children of disobedience.

familiar.text: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.

modern.text: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.

original.text: Μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς ἀπατάτω κενοῖς λόγοις, διὰ ταῦτα γὰρ ἔρχεται ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῆς ἀπειθείας.

verses.restored: Therefore do not become co-participants with them.

familiar.text: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.

modern.text: Therefore do not be partakers with them. Children of Light

original.text: μὴ οὖν γίνεσθε συμμέτοχοι αὐτῶν·

verses.restored: For you were once darkness, but now light in the Lord; walk as children of light,

familiar.text: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

modern.text: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

original.text: ἦτε γάρ ποτε σκότος, νῦν δὲ φῶς ἐν κυρίῳ· ὡς τέκνα φωτὸς περιπατεῖτε,

verses.restored: for the fruit of light is in all goodness and righteousness/justice and truth,

familiar.text: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

modern.text: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.

original.text: ὁ γὰρ καρπὸς τοῦ ⸀φωτὸς ἐν πάσῃ ἀγαθωσύνῃ καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ,

verses.restored: testing what is pleasing to the Lord.

familiar.text: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

modern.text: Test and prove what pleases the Lord.

original.text: δοκιμάζοντες τί ἐστιν εὐάρεστον τῷ κυρίῳ·

verses.restored: And do not participate in the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather expose them.

familiar.text: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

modern.text: Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.

original.text: καὶ μὴ συγκοινωνεῖτε τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς ἀκάρποις τοῦ σκότους, μᾶλλον δὲ καὶ ἐλέγχετε,

verses.restored: For the things done by them in secret are shameful even to speak of.

familiar.text: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

modern.text: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.

original.text: τὰ γὰρ κρυφῇ γινόμενα ὑπʼ αὐτῶν αἰσχρόν ἐστιν καὶ λέγειν·

verses.restored: But all things being exposed by the light are made manifest,

familiar.text: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.

modern.text: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.

original.text: τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐλεγχόμενα ὑπὸ τοῦ φωτὸς φανεροῦται,

verses.restored: for everything being made manifest is light. Therefore it says: Wake, sleeper, and rise from the dead, and Messiah will shine upon you.

familiar.text: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

modern.text: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

original.text: πᾶν γὰρ τὸ φανερούμενον φῶς ἐστιν. διὸ λέγει· Ἔγειρε, ὁ καθεύδων, καὶ ἀνάστα ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, καὶ ἐπιφαύσει σοι ὁ Χριστός.

verses.restored: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,

familiar.text: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

modern.text: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,

original.text: Βλέπετε οὖν ⸂ἀκριβῶς πῶς⸃ περιπατεῖτε, μὴ ὡς ἄσοφοι ἀλλʼ ὡς σοφοί,

verses.restored: redeeming the season, because the days are harmful.

familiar.text: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

modern.text: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

original.text: ἐξαγοραζόμενοι τὸν καιρόν, ὅτι αἱ ἡμέραι πονηραί εἰσιν.

verses.restored: Because of this, do not become foolish, but understand what is the will of the Lord.

familiar.text: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.

modern.text: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.

original.text: διὰ τοῦτο μὴ γίνεσθε ἄφρονες, ἀλλὰ ⸀συνίετε τί τὸ θέλημα τοῦ κυρίου·

verses.restored: And do not be drunk with wine, in which is excess, but be filled in Spirit,

familiar.text: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

modern.text: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.

original.text: καὶ μὴ μεθύσκεσθε οἴνῳ, ἐν ᾧ ἐστιν ἀσωτία, ἀλλὰ πληροῦσθε ἐν πνεύματι,

verses.restored: speaking to one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord,

familiar.text: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

modern.text: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,

original.text: λαλοῦντες ⸀ἑαυτοῖς ψαλμοῖς καὶ ὕμνοις καὶ ᾠδαῖς πνευματικαῖς, ᾄδοντες καὶ ⸀ψάλλοντες τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν τῷ κυρίῳ,

verses.restored: giving thanks always for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Messiah to the Divine and Father,

familiar.text: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

modern.text: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. Wives and Husbands (Song 1:1–17; 1 Peter 3:1–7)

original.text: εὐχαριστοῦντες πάντοτε ὑπὲρ πάντων ἐν ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τῷ θεῷ καὶ πατρί,

verses.restored: being subject to one another in reverence/fear of Messiah.

familiar.text: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

modern.text: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.

original.text: ὑποτασσόμενοι ἀλλήλοις ἐν φόβῳ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: Wives, to your own husbands as to the Lord,

familiar.text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

modern.text: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.

original.text: Αἱ γυναῖκες τοῖς ἰδίοις ⸀ἀνδράσιν ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ,

verses.restored: because a husband is head/source of the wife as also Messiah is head/source of the assembly, he himself savior/healer of the body.

familiar.text: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

modern.text: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.

original.text: ὅτι ἀνήρ ἐστιν κεφαλὴ τῆς γυναικὸς ὡς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς κεφαλὴ τῆς ἐκκλησίας, ⸀αὐτὸς σωτὴρ τοῦ σώματος.

verses.restored: But as the assembly is subject to Messiah, so also wives to husbands in everything.

familiar.text: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

modern.text: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.

original.text: ἀλλὰ ⸀ὡς ἡ ἐκκλησία ὑποτάσσεται τῷ Χριστῷ, οὕτως καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες ⸀τοῖς ἀνδράσιν ἐν παντί.

verses.restored: Husbands, love the wives, just as Messiah also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

familiar.text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

modern.text: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her

original.text: Οἱ ἄνδρες, ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς ⸀γυναῖκας, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν τὴν ἐκκλησίαν καὶ ἑαυτὸν παρέδωκεν ὑπὲρ αὐτῆς,

verses.restored: so that he might sanctify her, cleansing by the washing of water in word,

familiar.text: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,

modern.text: to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,

original.text: ἵνα αὐτὴν ἁγιάσῃ καθαρίσας τῷ λουτρῷ τοῦ ὕδατος ἐν ῥήματι,

verses.restored: so that he might present to himself the assembly in glory, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she may be holy and blameless.

familiar.text: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

modern.text: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.

original.text: ἵνα παραστήσῃ ⸀αὐτὸς ἑαυτῷ ἔνδοξον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, μὴ ἔχουσαν σπίλον ἢ ῥυτίδα ἤ τι τῶν τοιούτων, ἀλλʼ ἵνα ᾖ ἁγία καὶ ἄμωμος.

verses.restored: So also husbands ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. The one loving his own wife loves himself.

familiar.text: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

modern.text: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.

original.text: οὕτως ὀφείλουσιν ⸀καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες ἀγαπᾶν τὰς ἑαυτῶν γυναῖκας ὡς τὰ ἑαυτῶν σώματα· ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα ἑαυτὸν ἀγαπᾷ,

verses.restored: For no one ever hated one's own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, just as also Messiah the assembly,

familiar.text: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:

modern.text: Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church.

original.text: οὐδεὶς γάρ ποτε τὴν ἑαυτοῦ σάρκα ἐμίσησεν, ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφει καὶ θάλπει αὐτήν, καθὼς καὶ ὁ ⸀Χριστὸς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν,

verses.restored: because we are members of his body.

familiar.text: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

modern.text: For we are members of His body.

original.text: ὅτι μέλη ἐσμὲν τοῦ σώματος ⸀αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: For this reason a human will leave father and mother and be joined to wife, and the two will be into one flesh.

familiar.text: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

modern.text: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”

original.text: ἀντὶ τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος ⸀τὸν ⸀πατέρα καὶ ⸀τὴν μητέρα καὶ προσκολληθήσεται ⸂τῇ γυναικὶ⸃ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν.

verses.restored: This mystery is great; but I speak into Messiah and into the assembly.

familiar.text: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

modern.text: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.

original.text: τὸ μυστήριον τοῦτο μέγα ἐστίν, ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω εἰς Χριστὸν καὶ εἰς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν.

verses.restored: Nevertheless, you also, each one, let each love his own wife thus as himself, and the wife so that she may reverence the husband.

familiar.text: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

modern.text: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.

original.text: πλὴν καὶ ὑμεῖς οἱ καθʼ ἕνα ἕκαστος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα οὕτως ἀγαπάτω ὡς ἑαυτόν, ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἵνα φοβῆται τὸν ἄνδρα.

safety_note: Ephesians 5 household language must not be used to sanctify domination or abuse. The controlling frame is verse 21, mutual subjection in reverence of Messiah, and the husband's command is self-giving love patterned on Messiah, not control. Head/source language is debated and should be handled carefully.
